[package]
name = "accesskit_atspi_common"
version = "0.18.1"
authors = ["The AccessKit contributors"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "AccessKit UI accessibility infrastructure: core AT-SPI translation layer"
categories = ["gui"]
keywords = ["gui", "ui", "accessibility"]
repository = "https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit"
readme = "README.md"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"

[features]
simplified-api = []

[dependencies]
accesskit = "0.24.0"
serde = "1.0"

[dependencies.accesskit_consumer]
version = "0.36.0"
path = "../../consumer"

[dependencies.atspi-common]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false

[dependencies.phf]
version = "0.13.1"
features = ["macros"]

[dependencies.zvariant]
version = "5.4"
default-features = false

[package]
name = "accesskit_consumer"
version = "0.36.0"
authors = ["The AccessKit contributors"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "AccessKit consumer library (internal)"
categories = ["gui"]
keywords = ["gui", "ui", "accessibility"]
repository = "https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit"
readme = "README.md"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"

[dependencies]
accesskit = "0.24.0"

[dependencies.hashbrown]
version = "0.16"
default-features = false
features = ["default-hasher"]

[package]
name = "copypasta"
version = "0.10.2"
authors = ["Christian Duerr <contact@christianduerr.com>"]
description = "copypasta is a cross-platform library for getting and setting the contents of the OS-level clipboard."
repository = "https://github.com/alacritty/copypasta"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/copypasta"
readme = "README.md"
license = "MIT / Apache-2.0"
keywords = ["clipboard"]
exclude = ["/.travis.yml"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.71.0"

[features]
default = ["x11", "wayland", "wayland-dlopen"]
x11 = ["x11-clipboard"]
wayland = ["smithay-clipboard", "raw-window-handle"]
wayland-dlopen = ["smithay-clipboard/dlopen"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.clipboard-win]
version = "5.4.0"
features = ["std"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.5.1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.2.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSArray", "NSString", "NSURL"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.2.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSPasteboard"]

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(any(target_os=\"macos\", target_os=\"android\", target_os=\"ios\", target_os=\"emscripten\"))))".dependencies.x11-clipboard]
version = "0.9.1"
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(any(target_os=\"macos\", target_os=\"android\", target_os=\"ios\", target_os=\"emscripten\"))))".dependencies.smithay-clipboard]
version = "0.7.0"
default-features = false
optional = true

[target."cfg(all(unix, not(any(target_os=\"macos\", target_os=\"android\", target_os=\"ios\", target_os=\"emscripten\"))))".dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6.2"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dev-dependencies.winit]
version = "0.30.13"
default-features = false
features = ["wayland", "wayland-dlopen", "rwh_06"]

[package]
name = "linebender_include_doc_path"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Helper macro for linking to files in docs.rs."
keywords = ["macro", "doc"]
categories = ["filesystem"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/linebender/xilem"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
proc-macro2 = "1.0.106"
quote = "1.0.45"

[package]
name = "masonry"
version = "0.4.0"
description = "Traits and types of the Masonry toolkit."
keywords = ["gui", "ui", "toolkit"]
categories = ["gui", "internationalization", "accessibility"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/linebender/xilem"
exclude = ["screenshots", "examples/assets"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = []

[features]
default = ["masonry_core/default", "imaging_vello"]
imaging_vello = ["masonry_winit/imaging_vello"]
imaging_vello_hybrid = ["masonry_winit/imaging_vello_hybrid"]
imaging_vello_cpu = ["masonry_winit/imaging_vello_cpu"]
vello_cpu_multithreading = ["masonry_winit/vello_cpu_multithreading"]
vello_cpu_fallback = ["masonry_winit/vello_cpu_fallback"]
imaging_skia = ["masonry_winit/imaging_skia"]
tracy = ["masonry_core/tracy"]
testing = ["dep:masonry_testing"]

[dependencies]
accesskit = "0.24.0"
smallvec = "1.15.1"
resvg = "0.47.0"
understory_virtual_list = "0.1.2"

[dependencies.masonry_core]
version = "0.4.0"
path = "masonry_core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.masonry_testing]
optional = true
default-features = false
version = "0.4.0"
path = "masonry_testing"

[dependencies.tracing]
features = ["default"]
version = "0.1.44"
default-features = false

[dependencies.include_doc_path]
version = "0.1.0"
path = "include_doc_path"
package = "linebender_include_doc_path"

[dev-dependencies]
accesskit_consumer = "0.35.0"
divan = "0.1.21"

[dev-dependencies.float-cmp]
version = "0.10.0"
features = ["std"]
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.image]
features = ["png"]
version = "0.25.10"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.insta]
version = "1.46.3"

[dev-dependencies.masonry_testing]
default-features = false
version = "0.4.0"
path = "masonry_testing"

[dev-dependencies.masonry_winit]
default-features = false
version = "0.4.0"
path = "masonry_winit"

[dev-dependencies.profiling]
version = "1.0.17"
features = ["profile-with-tracing"]

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "deny"
keyword_idents_2024 = "forbid"
non_ascii_idents = "forbid"
non_local_definitions = "forbid"
unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = "forbid"
elided_lifetimes_in_paths = "warn"
missing_debug_implementations = "warn"
missing_docs = "warn"
trivial_numeric_casts = "warn"
unnameable_types = "warn"
unreachable_pub = "warn"
unused_import_braces = "warn"
unused_lifetimes = "warn"
unused_macro_rules = "warn"
unused_qualifications = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(compile_stress_test)"]

[lints.clippy]
too_many_arguments = "allow"
allow_attributes_without_reason = "warn"
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"
cast_possible_wrap = "warn"
collection_is_never_read = "warn"
default_trait_access = "warn"
dbg_macro = "warn"
debug_assert_with_mut_call = "warn"
doc_markdown = "warn"
fn_to_numeric_cast_any = "warn"
infinite_loop = "warn"
large_stack_arrays = "warn"
mismatching_type_param_order = "warn"
missing_assert_message = "warn"
missing_fields_in_debug = "warn"
same_functions_in_if_condition = "warn"
semicolon_if_nothing_returned = "warn"
should_panic_without_expect = "warn"
todo = "warn"
unseparated_literal_suffix = "warn"
use_self = "warn"
cargo_common_metadata = "warn"
negative_feature_names = "warn"
redundant_feature_names = "warn"
wildcard_dependencies = "warn"

[[bench]]
name = "widget_list"
harness = false
test = true

[[example]]
name = "calc_masonry"
doc-scrape-examples = true
